alarm-pylon.summary: A 5-ft runed stone post. Magic action: arm it with one trigger (a spell of a chosen school is cast, a creature takes 5+ damage, or an object takes 10+ damage); when that happens within 300 ft it rings for 10 seconds, heard up to 300 ft off. Another Magic action disarms it.

silencing-satchel.summary: 3 charges, 1d3 back each dawn. Magic action, 1 charge: a creature you see within 60 ft makes a DC 15 CHA save or is cursed for 1 minute with its mouth sealed (no Verbal spells, potions, food or drink), saving again at the end of each of its turns.

sync-ring.summary: On attuning, link a blank book you touch; anything you write with the ring hand is copied into it (magical writing copies as mundane text). Attunement ends if the book fills up or sits on another plane for over 24 hours.

unraveling-cloak.summary: Magic action: unbutton the hood and the cloak trails a thread behind you, spotted only with a Search and a DC 15 WIS (Perception) check. It stops after 100 miles or when you rebutton it (Magic action); teleporting destroys the thread so far.

wand-of-misdirection.summary: 4 charges, 1d4 back each dawn; spend 1 to cast Mislead.
